'''Ruuria''' was an astronomical object located in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]] along the [[Hydian Way]]<ref name="Appendix" /> that was the [[homeworld]] of the [[Ruurian]] [[species]]. It was noted for having [[Color|pink]] [[Water|rivers]], along the banks of which [[chroma-wing]]s would eat, fly, and mate.<ref name="The Rebellion Begins" />
